scenes.title: brick steps up front
scenes.note: a white cash brick falls and squashes; $330M lands whole on its face; on 'Up front' the brick steps toward the camera out of the frame plane and UPFRONT prints on it; camera pushes in with it

scenes.title: three vials on the Starna tray
scenes.note: 'Pfizer licenses' drops in; the Starna tray springs in from depth on 'license'; on 'three' three vials fall onto it one after another and squash (camera cranes); lead-in retires; PRE-IND drops under the tray; STARNA prints on the tray on 'Starna'

scenes.title: seven milestone bricks queue behind
scenes.note: the $330M brick returns marked PAID, springing in from depth on 'up to'; on '$2.3' seven grey bricks (~$2.3B / $330M) rise one by one in a row receding behind it while the camera pulls back; UP TO $2.3B / in milestones lands on 'billion'

scenes.title: the CAR-T bag
scenes.note: an IV bag drops on its line from the chrome and swings to rest (one overshoot, still) on 'CAR T has'; FOR CANCER prints on it on 'always' with a push-in

scenes.title: the ex vivo round trip
scenes.note: patient and lab flask spring in on 'Remove'; on 'T-cells' a cell arcs out of the patient into the flask (camera cranes down with it); on 'Engineer' red receptors spring out of it; on 're-infuse' it arcs back into the patient (camera pulls back); the three costs drop word by word; on 'Starna's' the lab falls out of the frame

scenes.title: RNA goes in, cells turn red
scenes.note: a large ink patient springs in; on 'engineer' a red RNA capsule flies from deep z into the chest and vanishes (camera pushes in with it); on 'T-cells' five cells pop in inside the body; on 'inside' they turn red one by one
